steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in as username admin with password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type the password text exactly as {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}; the browser fills it in). After signing in, report whether you are logged in as admin.

02-find: Go to the project named '{{01-signin.first_name}} Project' in OpenProject. In its work packages list, find all work packages whose subject starts with 'Seed:' and report their subjects EXACTLY as shown (do not modify anything). If the full list needs pagination or filters, make sure you see all of them.

03-create: In {{01-signin.first_name}} Project, create a new work package of type Task with subject '{{runid}} {{01-signin.first_name}} Work Package' and a description that includes the text '{{runid}}'. Save it, then report the work package's numeric ID as OpenProject displays it (shown as #<number>) and confirm the subject and type.

04-edit: On the work package page for {{03-create.work_package_reference}} (Task: {{runid}} {{01-signin.first_name}} Work Package) in {{01-signin.first_name}} Project, edit the following in-place fields and verify each saved: (1) set the Assignee to the user '{{01-signin.first_name}} Assignee' — it's an autocomplete, so actually pick '{{01-signin.first_name}} Assignee' from the dropdown options; (2) set the Status to 'In progress'; (3) set the finish date to 2026-12-31. Note these fields are edited in place by clicking them and they save automatically. Report the final values shown for assignee, status, and finish date.

05-add: On the work package {{03-create.work_package_reference}} page (Task: {{runid}} {{01-signin.first_name}} Work Package), add a comment whose text includes '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Progress note for {{runid}}'). Submit it, and report the comment text as displayed in the activity feed. Also verify and report the work package's currently displayed assignee, status, and finish date.
